title: Welcome new property lead
description: Reply to a new property enquiry on WhatsApp with the agent's name and next steps. Utility-leaning welcome template for agencies.
notes: Send within minutes of the enquiry form; it is a response to the user's own request and is typically approved as utility.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for your interest in *{{property}}*. I am {{agent}} from Acme Realty and I will help you with details, pricing and viewings. When would you like to visit?
